result.title: MOVER: Planning Beyond Motion
result.summary: Residual world models forecast a driving scene through its temporal change, so feature components that stay constant over time vanish from the residual pathway. We ask whether evidence with weak temporal change, such as a waiting pedestrian or a stopped vehicle, can be used more effectively for planning, and introduce MOVER, a complementary event-routing mechanism. A training-time teacher measures how each spatially grounded event query responds when a past frame is removed from shared history and contrasts that sensitivity with the event's pooled temporal residual, prioritizing events that depend on history but receive weak residual evidence. A student predicts the resulting priorities from unperturbed history, so the teacher adds no inference cost. Under fixed total routing mass, one distribution scales a low-rank future bird's-eye-view update and biases trajectory-conditioned event reading. On nuScenes, MOVER reduces ResWorld's UniAD-style average L2 from 0.65 to 0.55 m and its collision rate from 0.23% to 0.12% without direct planner ego status (0.50 m and 0.09% with it), adding 4.1 ms per frame. Matched controls show that the complementary teacher outperforms either signal alone and that the allocation acts mainly during training. Adapted to BridgeDrive-LEAD, MOVER reaches a 96.52 +/- 0.65 driving score over three seeds on the 220-route Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark, exceeding matched controls in each paired seed by a margin within seed variation.

AI.brief_summary: 针对残差世界模型会丢弃弱时变线索（如等待的行人、静止车辆）的问题，论文提出 MOVER：训练期教师通过删除历史帧测量各空间事件查询的敏感度，并与该事件的池化时间残差对比，优先选出「依赖历史但残差证据弱」的事件；学生从无扰动历史预测这些优先级，再以固定总质量的路由分布缩放低秩 BEV 更新并偏置轨迹条件的事件读取，推理不增加教师开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其基于扰动敏感度的事件证据筛选与训练期教师—学生路由，可能可供核查 LVR 中「哪些视觉证据应写入 latent 状态」及如何以低成本监督证据分配；但该工作面向自动驾驶规划，未涉及多模态 latent 推理，迁移性需进一步确认。
